source_title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection day 12: Rajinikanth, Hrithik Roshan's film earns Rs 9.45 cr on Monday; w - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' witnessed a sharp decline in box office earnings on its second Monday, October 26. The Nelson Dilipkumar directorial collected Rs 9.45 cr in India net earnings across 10,450 shows. Despite the weekday slowdown, the action entertainer has crossed the Rs 400 cr domestic net milestone. Its India gross collection stands at Rs 477.85 cr, while the worldwide gross has reached Rs 733.35 cr.According to Sacnilk, the film earned Rs 5.65 cr from Tamil screenings, followed by Rs 2 cr from Telugu shows. The Hindi version contributed Rs 1.40 cr, while Kannada added Rs 40 lakhs. Overseas markets generated Rs 2.50 cr on Monday, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 255.50 cr. The film recorded 714,175 ticket sales during the day, with total footfalls reaching 27,139,185.'Jailer 2' box office collection sees Monday declineThe film's domestic net collection dropped 63.2% from Sunday's reported earnings of Rs 25.70 cr. Monday's occupancy across all languages stood at 19.8%, indicating a considerable slowdown after the second weekend.The film opened in theatres on October 15 with Rs 59.70 cr. Friday brought in Rs 37.10 cr, followed by Rs 47.25 cr on Saturday and Rs 55.85 cr on Sunday. The first Monday recorded Rs 42.35 cr, while Tuesday added Rs 46.80 cr. Wednesday's collection stood at Rs 28.15 cr, followed by Rs 17.15 cr on Thursday. The opening week accumulated Rs 334.35 cr.Second weekend collections and Sunday figureDuring its second weekend, 'Jailer 2' collected Rs 14.50 cr on Friday, October 23, before improving to Rs 24.15 cr on Saturday. Sunday's reported domestic net collection was Rs 25.70 cr, making it the strongest day of the second weekend.The Sunday figure of Rs 25.70 cr is consistent across the supplied collection details and the reported day-wise breakdown. Monday's earnings subsequently fell to Rs 9.45 cr.Tamil version leads language-wise performanceThe Tamil version remained the biggest contributor, earning Rs 5.65 cr from 4,518 shows and recording 25.1% occupancy. Telugu screenings collected Rs 2 cr across 1,771 shows, with occupancy at 24.2%. Hindi shows earned Rs 1.40 cr from 3,949 screenings, registering 11% occupancy. Kannada contributed Rs 40 lakhs through 212 shows, with occupancy reaching 32%.The Tamil version recorded 17.85% morning occupancy, 26.92% in the afternoon, 31.15% in the evening and 29.31% at night. Its overall occupancy was 26.31%. Hindi occupancy stood at 9.83% in the morning, 12.58% in the afternoon, 13.50% in the evening and 16.08% at night, with an overall figure of 13%. Telugu recorded 13.67% morning occupancy, 19% in the afternoon, 17.17% in the evening and 21.17% at night. Its overall occupancy was 18.07%.Tamil Nadu generated Rs 4 cr in gross earnings on Monday, leading the state-wise report. Karnataka contributed Rs 2.35 cr, while Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together accounted for Rs 1.90 cr. Kerala added Rs 1.25 cr, and the remaining Indian markets contributed Rs 1.50 cr. The tracked state-wise gross total was Rs 11 cr.Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, 'Jailer 2' features Rajinikanth, Ramya Krishnan, Mohanlal, Yogi Babu, Vinayakan, Vidya Balan, Hrithik Roshan, Jackie Shroff, Shivarajkumar and Vijay Sethupathi. Vijay Kartik Kannan handled cinematography, Anirudh Ravichander composed the music, and R. Nirmal edited the film.
